1.consolidated_definition: alim. Emparedado, hamburguesa. Tortita de carne picada que se come con ensalada en un panecillo. Forma abreviada de hamburger. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Compuestos: veggie burger, cheeseburger, hamburger. Quería ante todo terminar y comerme el rico burger que tenía ante mí (ejemplo creado)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Food item. A patty of ground meat served with salad in a small bun. Abbreviated form of hamburger. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Compounds include veggie burger, cheeseburger, and hamburger. I wanted to finish and eat the rich burger that was in front of me (example created)
